marc:datafield.marc:subfield: நான் மனம் பேசுகிறேன் : நீங்கள் விரும்பும் அனைத்தையும் அடைவதற்கான மாயத் திறவுகோல் : என்னைச் சரிக்கட்டிவிட்டால் எல்லாம் சரியாகிவிடும்! | Naan manam pesugiren : Neengal virumbum anaithaiyum adaivatharkaana maaya thiravukool : Ennai sarikkattivittal ellam sariyaagividum!

This book explores the profound power of the mind and its impact on human life. The author, Deep Thirivethi, aims to increase the number of people who master their minds, thus enhancing their happiness and success. The book delves into the unity and differences between the mind and brain, the various states of the mind, its power centers, and the keys to success. It also examines the distinctions between wisdom and intelligence, emphasizing that those who conquer their minds often achieve extraordinary success and fulfillment.
